pages.title: Kiminou Knox Poetry | Faith, Love, Discipline, and Black Boyhood
pages.description: Read selected poetry excerpts by Kiminou Knox across faith, love, discipline, healing, identity, and Black boyhood, with links to books and author pages.
pages.intro: A reader-first archive for the poems, books, and recurring themes in Kiminou Knox's work. Start with the excerpts, then move into the full collections.

sections.heading: Core Themes
sections.text: Faith, discipline, healing, love, Black boyhood, knowledge, identity, and purpose run through Kiminou Knox's poetry and public writing.

sections.heading: Where To Go Next
sections.text: Use this page as the clean archive, then read the books page, author profile, and individual poetry theme pages for deeper context.

excerpts.title: Future Tense
excerpts.text: You are possibility. You are brilliance. You are the answer to prayers your ancestors whispered in the dark.

excerpts.title: Divine Silence
excerpts.text: Maybe silence is an answer. Maybe waiting is worship. Maybe faith was never meant to be comfortable.

excerpts.title: What Remains
excerpts.text: When the last applause fades, when the crowds disperse, when the mirrors show only the man beneath the myth - what remains?

pages.description: Selected faith poetry by Kiminou Knox from Our Father? and related work on God, doubt, prayer, purpose, and spiritual honesty.
pages.intro: Kiminou Knox writes about God with reverence and honesty. The faith poems hold prayer, doubt, silence, purpose, and the pressure of still believing.

sections.heading: Why This Lane Matters

excerpts.title: Questions in the Dark
excerpts.text: I am still here, still speaking to the silence, still hoping you're listening.

pages.title: Discipline Poetry by Kiminou Knox | Excellence, Sport, and Voice
pages.description: Poetry and writing by Kiminou Knox on discipline, excellence, athletics, creative work, and the cost of showing up.
pages.h1: Discipline on the page and on the court
pages.intro: The basketball work and the writing work meet here: repetition, focus, faith, pressure, and the responsibility to keep building when attention is not guaranteed.

sections.heading: The Thread
sections.text: Discipline is the bridge between Kiminou's books, sport, speaking, and youth work.

excerpts.title: The Court and the Page
excerpts.text: People ask how I balance basketball and writing. I do not. They have never been separate.

excerpts.title: The Weight of Choosing
excerpts.text: Between right and easy, I chose comfort. Between truth and peace, I chose silence.

pages.intro: This page gathers the poems and ideas that speak to boys, men, silence, vulnerability, and the slow work of learning to tell the truth.

sections.heading: Reader Path

excerpts.title: The Quiet
excerpts.text: Silence does not heal wounds. It just lets them sit in the dark.

excerpts.title: Breaking Point
excerpts.text: There comes a moment when the weight becomes too much, when the mask cracks, when the walls crumble.

pages.title: Love Poetry by Kiminou Knox | Hopeless Romantic and Honest Lines
pages.description: Love poetry by Kiminou Knox from Hopeless Romantic and related writing on heartbreak, tenderness, closure, longing, and honest love.
pages.intro: The love poems are direct, young, wounded, hopeful, and specific. They belong to the same public voice as the faith poems: honest before polished.

sections.heading: Book Lane
sections.text: Hopeless Romantic is the direct book path for readers who find Kiminou through love poems, heartbreak quotes, and tender lines.

excerpts.title: After You
excerpts.text: Love taught me how to open. Loss is teaching me how to close the things that need closing.

excerpts.title: Hope is a Dangerous Thing
excerpts.text: I would rather believe too much than believe too little.
